attributes.name: Deal with a Demon
attributes.powers:
Display this barrier next to the scenario; it is defeated. If another barrier is next to the scenario, banish 1 of them.

While displayed, each time a character encounters a henchman or villain, you may roll 1d12. On an odd result, the difficulty of checks to defeat the villain is increased by that amount; on an even result, add that amount to your checks to defeat.
